recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic landscape photograph of two men in dark, textured winter clothing standing on a rocky cliff overlooking a black sand beach with crashing white waves, framed by a thick white border containing asymmetrical typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark, heavy textures of the clothing and the bright, airy white border
Horizontal tension between the left-aligned serif header and the right-aligned script footer
Visual weight balance between the large rock formation on the left and the two subjects on the right
coreInvariants: Wide white border framing a central rectangular image
Combination of formal serif and informal cursive handwriting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photograph acts as the primary anchor, with the white border providing a secondary structural frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left serif text, moves down into the gaze of the subjects, follows the coastline to the bottom-right script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of white negative space in the outer border to focus attention on the central imagery.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and navy (clothing and volcanic sand)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between the dark subjects and the bright environment.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif and fluid monoline script
letterConstructionRules: Upper-case serif with high stroke contrast and sharp serifs
Lower-case cursive script with connected glyphs and a slight upward tilt
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand in the serif line is simplified and elegant
The script features long, expressive entry and exit strokes

composition.position: Top left of the white border
Bottom right of the white border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal/Informal contrast: The rigid serif provides authority while the script adds a personal, organic touch.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal alignment with the image edges

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classical, authoritative serif feel of the top text.
Provides the fluid, connected cursive look for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of two men in dark wool coats and scarves standing on a rocky Icelandic cliff. In the background, a black sand beach with white surf and a large sea stack under a moody, overcast sky. Frame this image inside a thick, solid white square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, wide-tracked all-caps serif title in the top left corner of the white border. Place a medium-sized, fluid handwritten script title in the bottom right corner of the white border.

verificationChecks: Is the border perfectly white and uniform?
Are the subjects wearing textured, dark winter clothing?
Is the text positioned outside the image area?
Is the color palette desaturated and cool?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grading
Specific placement of the subjects (left vs right)
mustRedesign: Any specific band logos or crests
Specific facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text does not overlap the photo
Ensure the serif text is small enough to feel minimalist
Verify the horizon line is level
Confirm the white border is consistent on all four sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Landscape + Wide White Border + Asymmetrical Serif/Script Pairing
